messages.author: Priya Raman
messages.text: Letter says one excursion up to 24 h at or below 25 °C is fine. 9155 has only this one. 9120 had ALM-2026-0122 in January, so this is its second.

messages.author: Miriam Hale
messages.text: If anyone wants to release 9120 on an exception, that is a written request to me and Léa, not a chat message.

messages.author: Kenji Sato
messages.text: Sørensen is on the 200 mg vials — different lot, not in fridge B.
